# doodle-jump (tour-agent-maker)

**Path:** `games/doodle-jump_tour-agent-maker.html`
**Generated by:** Tour Agent Maker
**Size:** ~1,063 lines (single file)

## What it is

A Doodle Jump clone — fully self-contained HTML file (HTML + inline CSS + inline `<script>`). Open in any browser; no build, no dependencies.

## Style / approach

- Uses CSS custom properties (`--ink`, `--accent`, `--green`, `--blue`, `--brown`, `--white`) — the most "design-system-aware" of the three variants.
- Cream background (`#f4efe0`), full-viewport absolutely-positioned canvas.
- HUD positioned absolutely in the top-left/right with `pointer-events: none`.
- Comic Sans / Marker Felt / Trebuchet MS font fallback chain.

## How to run

```bash
open games/doodle-jump_tour-agent-maker.html
```

## When to use as reference

Pick this variant when you want to see token-driven CSS structure in a single-file game. Compare with [[doodle-jump_claude-opus-4-7]] (more opinionated visuals) and [[doodle-jump_gemini-cli]] (leanest code).
